grammar.numbers: number inside the glowing core, an orbit arc sweeping round it as a radial gauge (a second number at once rides as a moon on the outer orbit)
grammar.comparisons: two planets with orbit arcs and the shrunken core as the VS node between them
grammar.steps: vertical glowing timeline starting at the docked core; each point a node that lights up, text on a glass card
grammar.change: classic change cue, old value slides out, new value slides in (MotionTrack value-swap)
grammar.lenders: logo tile spirals in on an orbit and docks on the core, neutral label
grammar.captionPosition: fixed band under the core, English line in a glass box at the bottom

skinAxes.cover: the core and orbit rings on deep navy, logo tile on white, title under the core
skinAxes.captions: clean white words, the current word glows, keywords amber
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; the voice-reactive core is the presenter
skinAxes.transitions: core moves and resizes between hook, figures, points and compare; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: starfield drift, thin orbit rings with travelling dots, soft blue glow, glass panels
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
